contexts.text: That is called behind him (), which is posterior, and that before him, which is prior.
To pass over before anyone (), where the conjunction of good with truths is treated of, = more general presence. Explained.
Voluntary things are presented behind, or after (), and intellectual things, in front, or before.
What God was doing before the world was created... TCR 31:3. SE 3476.
What is before signifies what is within; and what is after, what is without.
As God was before the world...
